name: fixture-03-cjs-require
comment_legacy-cjs-dep: Intentionally NOT an npm-workspace dependency: workspaces symlink local packages, and Vite treats a symlinked package as 'linked source' rather than a pre-bundled dependency, which is an artifact of this monorepo layout, not of real-world npm installs. scripts/verify.mjs copies local-legacy-deps/legacy-cjs-dep into this fixture's node_modules/ as a real (non-symlinked) directory instead, matching how an actual npm-installed CJS package would be laid out.
